questions: What is a projection?
When the projection ends, does the image disappear?
What is a bearing?
If the bearing fails, can you still get where you are going?
What is the scale?
If the scale goes up, does the thing being shown get bigger?
What is accuracy?
If accuracy improves, are the locations now correct?
What is a fix?
If the fix is lost, are you back where you started?
What is a boundary?
If you cross a boundary, have you necessarily done something wrong?
What is a survey?
If the survey is repeated, should the answers stay the same?
What is control?
If you lose control, does everything start drifting?
What is a parcel?
If a parcel is transferred, has it reached a new place?
What is a traverse?
If a traverse does not close, are you necessarily lost?
What is coverage?
If coverage ends, are you unprotected?
What is a benchmark?
If the benchmark is raised, does everything else need to rise with it?
What is a station?
When the station is occupied, is anything being measured?
What is alignment?
If the alignment is off, will it pull to one side?
What is a footprint?
If the footprint gets larger, is it necessarily doing more damage?
